adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the no-`credentialId` branch (`else` under `if (destination.credentialId)`) calls `createEvent(c, event)` without providing the new `externalId` argument (see `await Promise.all(... map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event)))`). `CalendarManager.createEvent` now returns `EventResult` with `externalId` populated only from that optional argument, and downstream reference-building was changed to use `externalCalendarId: result.externalId` (replacing the previous `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`). Therefore events created via this legacy/no-credentialId path will produce results with `externalId` undefined, and any persisted booking references will lack `externalCalendarId`, which can misroute later update/delete logic that depends on it.
